notes: Names and community aliases are not ground-truth reward definitions.
Implemented events and proxies are objectives, not proof that a trained policy mastered them.
Other listed mechanics are roadmap entries; they have no dedicated reward detector in this release.

mechanics.name: Air Dribble

mechanics.verification: Actual recent learner ball touches with nose orientation and matching relative velocity.
